rows.text: I'm here for business. There are some things I wanted to ask you...
I didn't think you looked like a criminal. Well, I've got nothing else to do. We may as well chat for a while.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: What did you do to get locked up in here?
Ah... I don't really, uhhh, remember. But I'm not a robber or a thief, so it can't have been anything serious.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: But I just can't sit still. It was when they locked me up that I started misbehaving. At first, they had me locked up in the Realm-Keeping Commission penitentiary, but I was bored to tears, so I had to escape.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Obviously, that got me arrested for jailbreaking, so they got a prison with tighter security for me. But that place was just as boring. I couldn't help but escape again.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: That's how my criminal record just started to snowball, and it kept snowballing until I found myself in The Shackling Prison. If I actually do manage to make it out of here, I don't think they'll have anywhere else that can hold me.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: You seem to enjoy breaking out of prison?
Well, everyone needs hobbies and interests. Some go in search of money, others like fine food, but I'm a little unique... I am addicted to breaking out of prisons.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: The fun of solving a challenging problem, the excitement of escaping the guards, the joy of regaining your freedom... Ah! Is there anything more wonderful in this world than escaping from prison?
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: I have a saying: "Break out of jail once and you get a moment of joy, spend your life jailbreaking and you'll be happy forever!" I've actually become quite renowned for all my escapes. Some call me the "jailbreak master," and some are even begging to be my disciples.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Although, it is also said that: "A true master always maintains the heart of an apprentice." That is precisely why I have come to The Shackling Prison — to further my craft.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Why are you a cycrane...?

You wouldn't understand. Breaking out of prison is a dangerous game. It's best to find myself a substitute body. Plus, being able to fly allows me to see much further, which makes it easier to see gaps in security.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: As for where I got this thing from... I imagine one of the prison guards chucked it out. Either way, when I found it, it was just a pile of scrap metal. I had to put a lot of work into fixing it.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Then where is your real body?
I've been possessing this cycrane for so long that I often start to believe that this is my actual body. I don't even remember where my real body is anymore.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: But that's not important. I am happy with how I am at the moment. Going back to my real body now wouldn't bring me any joy.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Do the other prisoners not think it's weird that you look like this?

There's enough weird stuff going on in The Shackling Prison. A shapeshifter that can transform into other prisoners, a Jade Abacus that can think and talk... What I do is not a big deal at all in here.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Plus, I have another role — I'm the chief of logistics for the Arma Correctional Group. Prisoners have to rely on me to deliver whatever they bought from Arma.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Oh. You're new here, so you probably don't know about the Arma Correctional Group. It's fine. You'll come to understand that, in The Shackling Prison, there will always be times when you need the Group.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Do you have any jailbreaking tips you can share with me?

Honestly, I don't have any tricks or anything like that. The key is perseverance. Some convicts give up after just one or two attempts, but I can spend years researching how to break just a single lock.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Another thing is careful observation. Even the most tightly guarded prisons will have weak spots, but some of them are better hidden than others.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Take The Shackling Prison for example. Even though their security measures are so complicated they can drive a man insane, that borisin still managed to escape, no?
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: What are The Shackling Prison's weak spots?
Well, if I knew that, then I'd have escaped a long time ago, wouldn't I?
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: But, my many years of experience tell me that The Shackling Prison's greatest insurance is the surrounding moat. If only I had someone proficient in water magic with me, my escape would be a lot easier.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Were you here when the borisin escaped?
I was. I happened to be on a delivery that day, but I saw a group of borisin fighting their way out in the distance.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: The entire place was in chaos. Lots of prisoners used it as their chance to escape. Hmph, what kind of hero tries to capitalize on an advantage like that? If you've got the skills, then you should rely on nothing but yourself!
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: Then I'll get back to my jailbreaking.
rows.speaker: Shiratori

rows.text: I've got to go. I won't disturb you.
Then I'll get back to my jailbreaking.
rows.speaker: Shiratori
